items.title: Building Node.js applications with Sequelize ORM and Amazon Aurora DSQL
items.summary: Node.js teams can run Sequelize ORM on Amazon Aurora DSQL with only a few adaptations. This post builds a hotel reservation application that shows reusable patterns: UUID primary keys, IAM authentication through the Aurora DSQL connector, individual DDL execution, and optimistic concurrency control retry logic.
items.creator: Lasita Bhattacharya

items.title: Reducing storage initialization impact in Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL after snapshot restore
items.summary: When you restore an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL instance from a snapshot, the Amazon EBS volume hydrates lazily, so early queries can run 10x to 15x slower. This post walks through PostgreSQL-native prewarming techniques (pg_prewarm, VACUUM ANALYZE, and full table scans) and new monitoring fields to restore predictable performance faster after restore.
items.creator: Sandeep Modappady
